title: Application Catalogue
description: Catalogue of physical application products deployed across the estate — the concrete vendor products that realise the logical platforms defined in the Application Domains & Platforms Catalogue (APP-DAP).

meta.description: The physical applications (vendor products) deployed across the organisation, with their lifecycle status and TIME classification.
purpose: Records the real-world products and vendors that implement the logical application landscape
Tracks each application's deployment status from planning through to retirement
Classifies each application using the TIME model (Invest, Maintain, Tolerate, Eliminate) to guide investment decisions
Provides the physical-layer counterpart to APP-DAP, mapped via the Application Domains & Platforms ↔ Application Catalogue matrix (APP-DAP-CAT)

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

vendor.description: The company that supplies the product

aliases.description: Other names this product is known by — former names, internal nicknames, or suite names

status.description: Current deployment status of this application

lifecycle-stage.description: TIME model classification — the investment posture for this application
